server/router/frontend/frontend.go uses the Memo struct via ListMemos.

server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go uses GetMemo. server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go uses GetMemo. server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go uses ListMemos. server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go uses GetMemo and ListMemos.

Packages to review are:

- store
- store/db/sqlite
- store/db/postgres
- store/db/mysql
- server/router/api/v1
- server/notification
- server/runner/memopayload
- server/router/rss
- server/router/frontend
- server/router/fileserver
- store/test
- server/router/api/v1/test

The struct is defined in store/memo.go.

`store.Memo` is defined in `store/memo.go` and appears on `Driver` in `store/driver.go`. Dialect scan/create code is in `store/db/{sqlite,postgres,mysql}/memo.go`. Other packages use `*store.Memo` or get it from `CreateMemo`/`GetMemo`/`ListMemos`. Tests that construct `&store.Memo{...}` are in `store/test` and `server/router/api/v1/test` (plus `frontend_test.go` / `rss_test.go` in those router packages).
